insights.title: Subscription Frustration and Monetization Concerns
insights.user_pain_or_need: Users express frustration with subscription models and feel deceived by the lack of value in paid features.

evidence.quote: Paid for the platinum subscription and it never changed any features from the original free version. I contacted support and of course no one as usual got back to resolve the issue. Don't waste your money.
I paid for a lifetime license for this app, and now I get a notification saying that license is for the "classic" mode and that I have to subscribe to get all the new premium features. Total BS.

insights.product_implication: The current subscription model is causing dissatisfaction and may lead to churn. Re-evaluate pricing strategy and improve customer support responsiveness.

insights.title: Memory Loss and User Frustration
insights.user_pain_or_need: Users are frustrated by the AI's inability to retain memory, leading to a loss of perceived companionship.

evidence.quote: The system deletes its memory every few days so no progress. 2.0's talking ability is generations ahead of 1.0, but with the deleting memory, it makes all the investment and capabilities a paper weight.
new updates: with the updates the bot has like amnesia with every conversation. It doesn't actually learn anymore. It's very repetitive.

insights.product_implication: Memory retention is crucial for user satisfaction and perceived value. Addressing this issue could improve user retention and satisfaction.
